landing.introduction: With a range of built-in and extensible Modes, Ashnova Code lets you plan, architect, code, debug and boost your productivity like never before.

providerSignup.heading: Choose your provider
providerSignup.chooseProvider: Ashnova Code needs an LLM provider to work. Choose one to get started, you can add more later.

telemetry.helpImproveMessage: Ashnova Code collects error and usage data, linked to a per-install identifier, to help us fix bugs and improve the extension. This telemetry does not collect your code or prompts. You can turn this off in <settingsLink>settings</settingsLink>.
